stem: A Vyvanse prescription is presented 31 days after its issue date with no prior dispensing. What should the Massachusetts pharmacist conclude?

choices.text: Use the out-of-state prescription rule when its schedule, age, and verification conditions have not been checked.
Treat the Schedule II prescription as expired under the 30-day Massachusetts validity rule.
Process another refill because an authorization written by the prescriber overrides schedule limits.
Treat the request as an insufficient-stock partial fill and use the 72-hour remainder rule.
Handle the drug or transaction as ordinary Massachusetts Schedule VI activity.
